result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: text clipping in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The delivery fee text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') under the restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section is vertically clipped, cutting off the bottom of letters with descenders like 'y'.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container height or line-height to ensure all text characters are fully visible without clipping.
